content.text:
At 5, co-sleeping is still really common and the transition works best when it's gradual - start by sitting next to his bed until he falls asleep, then over a week or two move yourself a little further toward the door each night. A consistent pre-bed routine (same order, same time) is the other piece that makes the biggest difference.

Want the full night-by-night plan for getting Milo into his own bed? Reply YES and I'll send it.
